items.title: The new DNIS is busy
items.symptom: Callers hear busy. No agent phone rings.
items.log: CAMPAIGN Retail type=inbound state=NOT_RUNNING dnis=8005550101 script=hours agents_ready=6
items.resolution: Start the inbound campaign. A stopped campaign does not answer, even when agents are Ready and a script exists.

steps.q: What do you check first?
choices: Whether the inbound campaign is running
steps.why: The inbound topic: a campaign that is not running does not answer.

steps.q: Agents are Ready. Does that answer the DNIS?
choices: No. The campaign still has to be running
Only if the codec is G.729
steps.why: Ready agents do not help a stopped campaign.

steps.q: After it is started, what else must be true?
choices: The script and the DNIS belong to that running campaign
steps.why: The campaign needs its script and its number.

items.title: Predictive lines and an inbound queue
items.symptom: Abandon rate climbs after inbound agents were told to 'also take outbound'.
items.log: MODE predictive agents_outbound=4 agents_also_inbound=4 ABANDON climbing WINDOW=US-30d
items.resolution: Stop treating blended bodies as dedicated predictive agents. The dialer page's guidance is a larger dedicated team. Do not invent a new abandon percent.

steps.q: What is wrong with the staffing?
choices: Nothing, blended is a fourth campaign type
Predictive guidance wants a dedicated team, and these agents are also on inbound
steps.why: Blended is staffing. Predictive product guidance is about team size and dedication.

steps.q: Do you type a new Max Abandoned Call Percentage from memory?
choices: No. The page warns, and this lab does not cite a default percent
steps.why: Do not invent the number.

steps.q: Who is involved if the measurement window itself must change?
choices: A Five9 representative. US is described as a rolling 30 days
steps.why: The defaults page says a representative sets the window.

items.title: Dial stays grey
items.symptom: Agents paste from the CRM. Dial never enables.
items.log: MODE tcpa_manual_touch paste=blocked typed= dial=disabled preview_timeout=not_ready
items.resolution: The control is working. Type the external number. Dial enables on a match. Do not flip the campaign to another mode to get around it.

steps.q: Why is Dial disabled?
choices: Paste is blocked and nothing was typed
steps.why: TCPA manual touch requires typing.

steps.q: A preview times out. What happens?
choices: The agent goes Not Ready and nothing auto-dials
steps.why: That is the article.

steps.q: Which permission is about skipping, not pasting?
choices: User Can Skip Contact Records in TCPA Manual Touch
steps.why: Skipping is its own permission.

items.title: Everyone lands on Default
items.symptom: The IVR sounds right. The Billing skill never sees the call.
items.resolution: Select the Billing skill on the Skill Transfer. The community article says no skill routes to Default.

steps.q: Why Default?
choices: The module has no skill selected
steps.why: No skill selected goes to Default.

steps.q: How many skills should you put on the module if you want a clean report?
choices: The community article recommends one skill per module
steps.why: One skill keeps the report readable.

steps.q: What is the default disposition named for that module?
steps.why: The article says Abandon.

items.title: Last month's column is empty
items.symptom: A call variable was enabled this morning. Historical rows are blank.
items.log: CAV name=CustomerType reporting=on since=today custom_disp=Sale checked=no
items.resolution: Call variables are not historical. New calls can populate. Also check the custom disposition; Apply to All does not cover it.

steps.q: Will yesterday backfill?
steps.why: The article says they are not historical.

steps.q: The Sale disposition is custom and still empty. Why?
choices: Apply to All skipped custom dispositions
steps.why: Custom dispositions need their own check.

steps.q: Which permission edits the variables?
choices: User Can Skip Contact Records in TCPA Manual Touch
steps.why: That is the permission name.

items.title: Voice is up, Salesforce is blank
items.symptom: Agents hear the caller. The Lightning adapter never pops.
items.log: VOICE rtp=ok ADAPTER=salesforce WSS=blocked proxy=corporate package_pdf=2.46
items.resolution: The proxy must pass Secure WebSocket. Voice and the adapter are different channels. Recheck the package version against the current PDF before you freeze 2.46.

steps.q: What does a live call prove about the adapter?
choices: Nothing. The adapter is a separate path
steps.why: Plus adapters use HTTPS and WSS.

steps.q: The corporate proxy drops WebSocket. What do you change?
choices: The proxy, so it supports WSS
steps.why: The requirements say the proxy must support WSS.

steps.q: How should 2.46 appear in the ticket?
choices: As the number in the PDF you read, with a date
steps.why: Versions move.

items.title: Home agents would send the HQ address
items.symptom: A test shows the downtown office for an agent who works from home.
items.resolution: Register the dispatchable home location and retest. MyE911 history should then show that place. Do not add a dialing prefix.

steps.q: What is wrong?
choices: The registered location is not where the agent is
steps.why: Dispatchable location has to be real.

steps.q: How should the agent dial?
steps.why: The data sheet says direct 911.

steps.q: What confirms the fix?
choices: MyE911 history shows the home location and the invite
steps.why: History includes location and the SIP invite.

items.title: The caller hears silence after a pause
items.symptom: Audio works for a few seconds, then the caller hears nothing.
items.log: NAT layers=1 UDP_idle=15s keepalive=off codec=G.711 path=vpn split_tunnel_excludes=five9
items.resolution: Lengthen the UDP binding toward 30 seconds or add keepalives, and stop excluding Five9 from the split tunnel. Keep G.711. Do not treat a 20 ms ptime rumor as the PDF.

steps.q: Which timer matches the symptom?
choices: UDP idle shorter than 30 seconds with no keepalive
steps.why: The requirements use 30 seconds as the UDP idle planning number.

steps.q: The VPN excludes Five9 names. Is that correct?
choices: No. Do not exclude them from the split tunnel
steps.why: Keep Five9 inside the tunnel.

steps.q: What do you refuse to claim?
choices: That 20 ms ptime is a Five9 requirement
steps.why: 20 ms is a practitioner note, not a figure this lab quotes from the PDF.
